name: feature-explainer
description: Give it a feature's name and the reader (product, QA, design, development, sales/operations or everyone) and it builds a visual explainer page (a published artifact) for that audience: it researches the feature read-only (code, branches, tickets, docs, live calls when allowed), then draws the journey, who does what, rules as grids, annotated screens and states, what to test, architecture or a customer-facing overview, with dated issues and the right detail collapsed or left out. Bundles the page shell, a drawing kit of ready blocks, a build script with an audience-aware style lint, and layout checks (overflow, overlapping labels, phone width). Product-neutral: ships no product data.
